rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.005, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=20, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-12 n_cg localize (15 vs 20 vs 25), breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: at init_t0.005 the n_cg optimum is interior: n_cg5->hr0(RMSE5.94e-3), n_cg15->hr0.0695(4.85e-3 BEST), n_cg25->hr0.043(4.99e-3). Adding prior (init_t0.02,iter-11) hurt (hr0.012). So minimal-prior + n_cg~15 is the ridge. (2) FAILURE MODE: n_cg25 over-converged (LSQ noise); n_cg5 under-converged. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_n_cg 15 -> 20 (sample between the 15-peak and 25-decline to see if the optimum is >15). (4) HYPOTHESIS: n_cg=20 lands between hr0.0695 and hr0.043 (a smooth interior peak near 15-18); if it beats 0.0695 the true optimum is ~18-20, else 15 is optimal. (5) BUDGET ~3min. (6) iter-13 on landing.
